Class Simulator

java.lang.Object
domain.Simulator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Simulator extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a simulation instance in the system. Contains information about the user, selected map, scenario, budget, and current year. Implements Serializable to support object persistence.

    • Simulator

      public Simulator(User user, Map selectedMap, Scenario selectedScenario, Budget budget, int currentYear)
      Creates a new Simulator instance with the specified parameters.
      Parameters:
      user - The user associated with this simulation
      selectedMap - The map selected for this simulation
      selectedScenario - The scenario selected for this simulation
      budget - The budget for this simulation
      currentYear - The current year of the simulation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any required parameter is null or if the current year is outside the scenario's date range
